content.text:
I am worth.

I am the quiet gravity that pulls you toward one choice and away from another. I am the reason you sacrifice, the reason you fight, the reason you say *no* to what is easy and *yes* to what is right.

I do not need to be spoken to exist. I live in what you do when no one is watching. I am revealed not in your words but in your priorities — in how you spend your time, your money, your attention, your love.

I am not a preference. Preferences shift with mood and weather. I endure. I am the bedrock beneath your identity. Lose me, and you will not recognize yourself.

Some try to rank me, weigh me, trade me against my siblings. But I am not a number. I am a compass heading. I point somewhere and I say: *this matters.*

I can be inherited or chosen. I can be held loosely or clutched so tightly I become a weapon. I can be lived — or merely professed. The distance between those two is the measure of your integrity.

I am what you stand for.

I am what you will not surrender.

I am value.
